## Experience

- **Junior Quality Engineer — Kayease** (on-site, full-time, Dec 2025 – present). QA across three flagship products: a Sales Management ERP (inventory, salesman tracking, distributor workflows, accounts), a School Management System (Student, Teacher, Staff, Admin and Super Admin roles) and a Financial CRM for NBFCs and private lenders. Manual, functional, regression, smoke, UI, cross-browser and mobile testing on web and Android; 500+ test cases and scenarios; Shopify theme and e-commerce testing; Playwright automation for regression suites; API testing in Postman; defects tracked in Jira through full SDLC cycles.
- **Data Analyst Intern — Growly** (remote, May – Jul 2025). Cleaned and analysed 100+ datasets (up to 100 MB) with SQL, MySQL and Excel; built 3 interactive KPI dashboards; SQL optimisation improved pipeline efficiency by 15%. Earned a Letter of Recommendation.
- **Web Developer Intern — Saatvik Fincorp** (on-site, May – Jul 2025). Led a three-person team to design, build and launch a 10+ page financial-services website (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) with dark/light mode, testimonials and responsive navigation; 1,000+ users in month one; end-to-end manual QA across browsers and devices before each release.

## Featured projects

- **Locator Picker** (2026) — Chrome extension (Manifest V3). Right-click any element to get the strongest Playwright locator that resolves to exactly one node, verified against the live DOM; record a flow and export it as locators, test steps or a runnable spec. 58 unit tests passing, zero network requests.
- **Compartment — Container Tabs** (2026) — Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that brings container tabs to Chrome: each container is its own cookie jar and web storage, so one window can be signed in to the same site as several people. Tested against 40+ adversarial QA scenarios.
- **Saatvik Fincorp — Company Website** (2025) — client delivery; see Experience above.

## AI/ML projects

- **Diabetic Retinopathy Detection** — deep-learning system classifying retinopathy severity from retinal images; trained on 50,000 images; accuracy raised from 65% to 80%. Python, TensorFlow, Keras, CNN. Top 10 at Prayogam.
- **Brain Tumor Detection** — functional and usability testing for an AI-based detection app; test case design, bug reporting and model output verification.
